name: subscription-billing
annotation: HIFI-23 · /settings/billing · dark shell, top-center orange radial glow, floating nav pill. GlassStatCard current-plan surface is the singular focal moment; WarningBanner, PlanTierCard, CompareGrid, and CreditLedgerRow stay quiet, legible, and solid-surfaced below it.

modules.build: 44px back target. Title: Subscription & billing ('billing' in Newsreader Medium Italic).
Solid surface #211008. Orange accent. Copy: 'Payment failed - 3 days to update'. Tap opens update-payment sheet; acts as the screen's single BtnPrimary.

Glass card, orange glow. H2: Pro. Caption: $60/mo. Body: renews Jun 15, 2026. Provenance chip: 'via subscription API'. ChargeMeter label: '800 of 1,000 messages this cycle'. Muted text: 'credits 420'.
Horizontal swipe rail. Ghost pill text: 'Free · Plus · Pro · Max'. Pro marked active.
Solid surface #211008. Overline: 'Compare plans'. Headers: 'feature | current | recommended'. Rows: 'CIA coaching | x | x', 'voice | - | x'. Included/excluded features are glyph plus text.
Solid surface. Overline: 'Credits ledger'. Row 1: '+500 monthly grant' + subtext 'expires Aug 1'. Row 2: '-80 voice call' + subtext 'via usage'.

belowFold.build: ListRow. Solid surface. Title: 'Visa ....4242'. Subtitle: 'Billing history'. 44px tap target.
Ghost buttons. Text: 'Downgrade plan'. Text: 'Cancel subscription'. No false urgency, plain ghost styling.

trustControls: WarningBanner provides direct grace countdown from billing API without false urgency.
Downgrade and cancel actions are clearly visible as ghost pills below the fold.
Provenance chip 'via subscription API' explicitly links financial data.

Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete wherever billing data appears; navigation stays locked to /settings/billing and /settings/billing/credits, no alternate vanity routes (Consent and Safety).
notes: Only ONE BtnPrimary is allowed per screen. The WarningBanner's tap-to-update-payment action is that primary CTA; no other primary buttons render on this screen.
CompareGrid and CreditLedgerRow use solid #211008 surfaces to maintain dense data legibility, while the current-plan GlassStatCard holds the singular orange focal glow.
Nav pill spans y756-824, intentionally pushing 'Visa ....4242' and the downgrade/cancel actions safely below the fold even though their raw y-offsets sit under 844.
